products.name: AchatAI
products.card: Send a file you just made to someone, without swapping phone numbers first.
products.title: AchatAI: share with people you choose, no phone number needed
products.intro: AchatAI is a messaging app on the web and Android for the people you choose. You find someone by username, invite link or QR code, so a phone number never has to change hands.
sections: Why would a ZTools user need it?

You finish something in ZTools: a converted PDF, a QR code, notes from a meeting. Then it has to reach someone. AchatAI lets you find them by username or invite link, not by a number you would rather keep.
Can I talk to someone without an account?
Yes, in an anonymous room. You can open one without signing up, which suits a quick exchange with someone you will not talk to again.
Where does it run?
On the web and on Android.

products.name: CallVault
products.card: Meeting notes cover the meeting. CallVault keeps the phone call that came before it.
products.title: CallVault: a record of the calls you would otherwise take notes on
products.intro: CallVault records calls on Android through the audio source your phone makes available. Its library on the phone lets you play a call back, search it, add notes and export it.
sections: How does it fit next to ZTools’ meeting notes?

The ZTools meeting notes generator turns a meeting into notes you can use. Plenty of decisions happen on a phone call instead. CallVault keeps that call, so you can find the detail later and write it up.
Where are the recordings kept?
On your phone. They leave it only if you turn on private cloud backup.
What can I do with a recording?
Play it back, search the library, attach notes and export it.

products.name: Capacitor Auth Manager
products.card: For app developers: Google sign-in on web, Android and iOS from one call, with no Firebase dependency.
products.title: Capacitor Auth Manager: one Google sign-in call for three platforms
products.intro: Capacitor Auth Manager is an npm package that gives a Capacitor app one Google sign-in call for web, Android and iOS. It does not need Firebase as a dependency.
sections: Who is it for?
Developers building with Capacitor. If you use ZTools to format a JSON response while you build, this sits further along the same job: signing people in to the app you are making.
Which providers does it support?
Google. It is the only provider switched on in version 3.x.
Why does Firebase matter here?
Some apps do not use Firebase at all. With this package, Google sign-in does not pull it in.

products.name: ClearHire
products.card: The resume builder gets it on the page. ClearHire adds ATS checks and proof of where you worked.
products.title: ClearHire: after the resume template, the checks that get it read
products.intro: ClearHire is an ATS-friendly resume builder with structured profiles. It comes with more than 50 career tools, from writing bullet points to running ATS checks.
sections: How is it different from the ZTools resume builder?
The ZTools resume builder gets a resume on the page quickly. ClearHire covers the job hunt around it: a structured profile, ATS checks on what you wrote, and help with stronger bullet points.
What does verified employment mean?
ClearHire has workflows for verifying past jobs, so a profile can show proof of work history, not only claims.
Where can I use it?
On the web, and on Android from Google Play.

products.name: Eat This
products.card: Your calorie number, turned into food you can actually buy.
products.title: Eat This: from a nutrition number to something on your plate
products.intro: Eat This lets you look for food by nutrient, by how you feel or by the time of day. It shows how much of a nutrient one serving gives.
sections: Why after a ZTools calculator?
The ZTools calorie and macronutrient calculators give you a target. Eat This answers the next question: which food gets you there, and how much of it.
Does it help on a budget?
Yes. It points out a cheap pick among the foods that fit.
Is it medical advice?
No. Eat This also tells you when a question belongs with a doctor.

products.name: Empora
products.card: One WordPress plugin for store features, the way ZTools is one site for tools.
products.title: Empora: one plugin in place of a stack of WooCommerce plugins
products.intro: Empora puts WooCommerce store modules into one WordPress plugin. You switch on only the modules your store needs.
sections: Why would ZTools mention a store plugin?
ZTools exists because a separate website for every small tool is hard to keep track of. Empora applies the same idea to a WooCommerce store: one plugin to manage, not a separate one for each feature.
Do I have to use every module?
No. You choose which modules to switch on.
Where do I manage licenses?
In the Empora web dashboard, which also handles optional store connections.

products.name: HabitForge
products.card: Plan the day in ZTools. HabitForge keeps the habit going, check-in by check-in.
products.title: HabitForge: when a planner is not enough to keep a habit
products.intro: HabitForge shows your consistency as a rope. It thickens with every check-in and frays where you stopped.
sections: How does it relate to the ZTools planner and habit tracker?
The ZTools daily planner and habit tracker are quick, single-page tools. HabitForge is a full app built around one habit loop, with an account that works on the web and on Android.
Can I do it with friends?
Yes. There are friends, challenges and a leaderboard, and you can leave the leaderboard whenever you like.
Where does it run?
On the web and on Android, from one account.

products.name: LabFlow
products.card: For diagnostic labs that have outgrown spreadsheets and one-off calculators.
products.title: LabFlow: a diagnostic lab’s whole day in one system
products.intro: LabFlow runs a diagnostic lab end to end. Patients, orders, samples and results live in one system.
sections: Who is it for?
Labs, not individuals. If your lab still moves results between spreadsheets and quick online calculators, LabFlow keeps that work in one place.
How do results get released?
Through a validation workflow that takes each result from draft to released.
What else is included?
Billing, inventory and quality control are built in. It runs on the web and on Android.

products.name: LifeWell
products.card: A ZTools health calculator gives you one number. LifeWell keeps the record over time.
products.title: LifeWell: from a one-off health calculation to a daily record
products.intro: LifeWell lets you track your health your way: vitals, water, medicines, sleep and nutrition in one app. It syncs across your devices on the web and Android.
sections: Why move on from a ZTools calculator?
The ZTools BMI and waist-to-hip ratio calculators answer a question once. If you want to see how the numbers change, LifeWell keeps them with the rest of your day.
What does it track besides vitals?
Periods, fertility and baby milestones are included.
Where can I use it?
On the web and on Android, synced across your devices.

products.name: linux-cleanup
products.card: For developers on Linux: clear caches with a dry run first and a receipt after.
products.title: linux-cleanup: freeing disk space on a Linux developer machine
products.intro: linux-cleanup shows the cache paths it can remove before anything goes. You can inspect the limits and run a dry run before a real removal.
sections: How do I run it?
As a desktop app for x86_64 Linux, in AppImage and .deb, or as the MIT-licensed command line through npx.
Can a scan delete something?
No. Scan and dry run never delete. The desktop app runs a dry run before every real run and gives you a receipt after it.
Why is it on a tools site?
The ZTools developer tools help with the small jobs in a day of building software. A full disk is one of those jobs, and this one runs on your own machine.

products.name: macleanup
products.card: Cleaning a Mac without anything touching your personal folders.
products.title: macleanup: Mac maintenance that leaves personal folders alone
products.intro: macleanup is safe-by-default cleanup and maintenance for macOS. It refuses to touch personal folders, whatever it is asked to do.
sections: Will it show me what it plans to remove?
Yes. It runs a real dry run before anything is removed.
What does it clean?
It works through the same catalogue of cleanup sections as its Linux sibling, built for macOS.
Where do I get it?
From its GitHub repository.

products.name: Native Update
products.card: The update system the ZTools Android app uses to ship fixes without a store wait.
products.title: Native Update: how ZTools ships Android fixes the same day
products.intro: Native Update lets a Capacitor app take updates without waiting on the store. The ZTools Android app uses it: a fix that reaches the website can reach your phone as a live bundle update.
sections: What does it update?
The app’s web bundle, over the air. It also handles the in-app prompts for store updates and reviews.
Who runs the server?
You can host the backend yourself. It is open source.
Who is it for?
Developers shipping a Capacitor app. It is an npm package.

products.name: NetCage
products.card: Keep one Android app off the internet, on the schedule you choose.
products.title: NetCage: one app offline while the rest of your phone stays online
products.intro: NetCage can refuse Wi-Fi and mobile data to a chosen Android app while everything else stays connected. A rule can target Wi-Fi, mobile data or both.
sections: Can it follow a schedule?
Yes. Profiles group apps and apply rules on the days and times you choose.
When is that useful?
When one app uses up your data, or pulls you away during set hours, and you do not want to cut the connection for everything else.
Where does it run?
On Android.

products.name: PregnancyPal
products.card: After the due-date calculator: a week-by-week record you can share with a doctor.
products.title: PregnancyPal: what comes after the due-date calculator
products.intro: PregnancyPal tracks a pregnancy week by week, with nutrition and exercise alongside each week.
sections: Why after the ZTools calculators?
The ZTools pregnancy due-date and weight-gain calculators answer a question once. PregnancyPal keeps a record through every week.
What can I log?
Vitals, symptoms, mood and appointments.
Can I share it with my doctor?
Yes. It exports a doctor-friendly PDF. PregnancyPal runs on the web and on Android.

products.name: RentParty
products.card: Game night without counting play money: the bank runs itself.
products.title: RentParty: a property-trading game you can pause
products.intro: RentParty is a property-trading game you can pause and pick up later. The game handles the bank and keeps every deed in place when play resumes.
sections: How do people play together?
Pass one phone around, play against CPU characters, or open an online room.
Why does ZTools list a game?
ZTools has a dice roller for board game nights. RentParty is for the night you want the whole game on a phone, bank included.
Where does it run?
On the web and on Android.

products.name: SMS App
products.card: One reminder to a whole list, texted from the Android phone in your pocket.
products.title: SMS App: batch and scheduled texts from your own phone
products.intro: SMS App sends SMS at scale from your own Android device. You can send one message, a batch, or schedule them.
sections: Who is it for?
Anyone who texts the same reminder to many people, such as a volunteer group. It manages device registration and a volunteer pool.
Where do the messages go out from?
From your own Android phone. The app is Android-native and privacy-first.
How does it fit next to ZTools?
ZTools text tools help you write and tidy a message. SMS App sends it to everyone on the list.

products.name: Strata Storage
products.card: The storage layer under ZTools’ saved settings, for your own app.
products.title: Strata Storage: the storage API ZTools is built on
products.intro: Strata Storage is one storage API over localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies and native storage. ZTools uses it for the settings it keeps on your device.
sections: Which platforms does it cover?
The web, iOS and Android, with zero dependencies.
How does it keep secrets on a phone?
On native platforms it can use the Keychain and the Keystore.
Who is it for?
Developers. It is an npm package.

products.name: Tilawah
products.card: Live recitation lessons booked in your own timezone.
products.title: Tilawah: Quran lessons that fit your timezone
products.intro: Tilawah offers recorded Tajweed and Tafseer lessons you take at your own pace. It also books live one-on-one recitation sessions in your timezone.
sections: Why mention timezones?
Plenty of people open the ZTools timezone converter to set up a call across countries. Tilawah books live sessions in the learner’s own timezone, so that step is not needed.
Can I track my progress?
Yes, through the self-paced lessons.
Where is it?
On the web.

products.name: Trizlink
products.card: Made a QR code in ZTools? Point it at a short link you can count clicks on.
products.title: Trizlink: short links and click counts for what you share
products.intro: Trizlink makes branded short links with custom slugs and counts the clicks on them. It also builds link-in-bio pages.
sections: How does it work with a ZTools QR code?
The ZTools QR code generator turns a link into a code. If that link is a Trizlink short link, you can see how many people opened it.
Can I use my own domain?
Yes. Trizlink supports custom domains.
Does it have tools of its own?
More than 50 built-in utilities. It runs on the web and on Android.

products.name: Video Controls Plus
products.card: Studying from a lecture video: slow it down, loop a part, take timestamped notes.
products.title: Video Controls Plus: reviewing a lecture or tutorial video
products.intro: Video Controls Plus gives you full control of any HTML5 video in Chrome. Set the speed from 0.1× to 16×, loop from A to B and step frame by frame.
sections: Why is it good for studying?
A tutorial goes too fast in one place and too slow in another. Loop the hard part, slow it down, and keep timestamped notes beside it.
What else can it do?
Boost audio to 400%, adjust filters and color, take screenshots, and use more than 40 shortcuts.
How is it different from the ZTools video tools?
The ZTools video tools work on a file: compress it or turn it into a GIF. Video Controls Plus works on the video playing in your browser tab.

products.name: Waylock
products.card: Took a wrong turn on a delivery run? The route you chose stays on screen.
products.title: Waylock: getting back on route after a wrong turn
products.intro: Waylock is an Android planning layer over Google Maps for drivers and couriers. After a wrong turn, the route you chose stays visible beside the choice to return to it or take a new one.
sections: Can I fix some stops in place?
Yes. Hold the stops you choose and Waylock orders the rest around them.
Who is it for?
Drivers and couriers with several stops in a day.
Does it replace Google Maps?
No. It works as a planning layer over Google Maps.

products.name: windowsweep
products.card: Clean up a Windows PC from one npx command, with nothing to install.
products.title: windowsweep: Windows cleanup without installing anything
products.intro: windowsweep is a Windows cleanup command line you run with npx, so there is nothing to install. It names every path before it touches one.
sections: Does it delete straight away?
No. It runs a real dry run first, and you choose personal files row by row.
Does it send anything online?
No. It makes no network calls.
What does it cover?
30 sections. It also runs as a Windows desktop app.

copy.aboutDev.title: Built by Ahsan Mahmood
copy.aboutDev.lead: Ahsan Mahmood, who goes by aoneahsan, built ZTools because a separate website for every small job is easy to lose track of. ZTools is his answer: {toolCount} tools in one place.
copy.aboutDev.ideaBody: Someone needs an image resizer, and there is a site just for that. Then a PDF viewer, HTML to Markdown, or SVG to PNG, and each one has its own site again. ZTools puts those tools, and hundreds more, on one platform: on the web, on Android and as a browser extension.
copy.aboutDev.quote: “You don’t need 500 different websites bookmarked just to get your work done.”
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-01-15: The ZTools blog publishes its first guide.
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-09-25: Version 1.4 of the Chrome extension is live in the Chrome Web Store.
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-10-03: Accounts and saved data move to Supabase.
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-10-20: AI help and Speak, the voice tools, arrive.
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-10-27: The website gets a phone app view.
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-11-05: Version 2.31 of the Android app on Google Play.
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-11-21: An API, an MCP server for AI assistants, and two-step sign-in.
copy.aboutDev.j.2026-11-22: ZTools compared with 23 other sites, every price sourced and dated.
copy.aboutDev.built1: Many tools run in your browser. AI and some processing tools use a server, and each tool says which.
copy.aboutDev.built2: Accounts and saved data live in Supabase. Files you choose to keep are stored privately.
copy.aboutDev.built3: The Android app is built from the same code as the website, so a tool works the same way in both.
copy.aboutDev.built4: No ad networks. The only promotions in ZTools are for other Zaions products, and ZTools Pro turns them off.
copy.aboutDev.contactBody: Write to the ZTools team from the contact page. For help with a tool, the support page is the quickest start.
